appropriate_uses: Department of Defense budget requests, procurement quantities, program funding lines, and official budget-justification context.
inappropriate_uses: Treating requested procurement quantities as delivered inventory, operational availability, or classified stockpile totals.
known_failure_modes: Budget requests can differ from enacted appropriations and delivered production; program lines may omit classified or operationally constrained inventories.
name: DoD Comptroller Budget Materials
observables: budget requests, procurement quantities, program funding, fiscal-year justification
originating_chain_rule: Budget overviews, justification books, and component budget exhibits for the same fiscal-year request remain one DoD budget-submission chain.

review_history.note: Added for interceptor procurement and defense-budget verification context.
